newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste says to be self-sufficient in power.
newsitem.headline: Neste says to be self-sufficient in power.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Friday it would become self-sufficient in electricity when it starts a new gas turbine power generator in October.
Neste will invest almost 300 million markka in the generator currently under construction at its Kilpilahti industry site outside Porvoo in southern Finland, it said.

"Start-up of the new power unit will increase Neste's electricity output and make it self-sufficient in electricity," Neste said, adding that its production plants need an effect of 180 megawatts and use 1,400 gigawatt hours per year.
Neste said it was becoming increasingly important in energy and that it was active on Finland's electricity exchange.
